_README: Reclassify individual timecards into a different labor bucket when the Square job title
does not reflect what the shift actually was. Buckets: core | admin | training.
timecard_bucket_overrides  - keyed by Square timecard id. Use for one-off corrections.
team_member_bucket_overrides - list of rules matched on team_member_id, plus optional
cafe and inclusive from/to dates. Use when someone is in
a training period and every shift should reclassify.
Timecard-level overrides win over team-member rules. Every applied override is written to
`bucket_overrides_applied` in labor_<week>.json and surfaced in the report caveats.
timecard_location_overrides - keyed by timecard id: {"cafe": "<cafe name>"}. Moves a wrong-site punch to the cafe actually worked. Logged to `location_overrides_applied`.
